report.candidate_letter:
Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Data Scientist position. We will not move forward with your application, because your CV does not show the following required points: good knowledge of probability theory and statistics, understanding of Bayesian methods, time series analysis or sensor signal processing, hands-on experience with probabilistic programming (Pyro, PyMC3, JAGS or similar), experience with cloud (Amazon SageMaker), experience with PySpark, or strong working knowledge of SQL.

This decision was made after a human review. You have the right to reply with questions about the assessment.

Kind regards
